name: jevmod
description: Content moderation powered by Jev (TypeSafe): skills and an MCP server so a coding agent can add spam/scam/harassment/nsfw/self-harm/doxxing/minors moderation to any codebase.

plugins.name: jevmod
plugins.description: jevmod-integrate adds moderation to an existing codebase (Python SDK, npm, HTTP API or MCP; key handling; a real test). jevmod-moderate screens text or datasets with `jevmod check` or the MCP tools. Registers the `jevmod mcp` stdio server.
